bounded_remediation: Pin the adapter contract in the existing one-shot pip install and include it in the environment identity; regenerate assets before resubmission. Do not relax the adapter contract based only on this failure.

root_cause.finding: It installed source adapters without exact client pins. The mini-swe source declares litellm >=1.75.5 and unpinned tenacity/openai, so a new environment could resolve 1.102.1 while the adapter requires 1.102.0. The cache identity omitted the adapter dependency contract; job-side inventory validation checked receipt consistency but not adapter compatibility.
